info.title: Dutch Market API
info.description: Multi-vendor marketplace API. Authenticate with OAuth 2.0 (authorization code + PKCE, client credentials) or a first-party token from `/api/v1/auth/login`.

post.description:
Admin accounts cannot be created through the API. Returns an access token whose
scopes are limited to what the role allows.
post.summary: Register a buyer or vendor account

post.description: Third-party integrations should use the OAuth 2.0 flows under `/oauth/*`.
post.summary: Log in with email and password and receive an access token (first-party apps)

get.summary: Show the authenticated user's cart with live prices and totals per currency

post.summary: Add a product (quantities add up if it is already in the cart)

patch.summary: Set the quantity of a product already in the cart

delete.summary: Remove one product from the cart

get.description:
`role=buyer` (default) lists orders you placed; `role=vendor` lists orders placed with
your shop. Optional `status` filter. Paginated, newest first.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.description: Creates one order per vendor, reserves stock, and returns the new orders awaiting payment.

post.summary: Buyer confirms receipt; escrow is released to the vendor
Buyer cancels an order that has not been paid yet
Vendor marks a paid order as shipped. Requires `vendor:manage`

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

post.summary: Create a product owned by the authenticated vendor. Requires `catalog:write`

put.summary: Update one of your own products. Requires `catalog:write`

delete.summary: Delete one of your own products. Requires `catalog:write`

scopes.catalog:write: Create, update and delete your own products
scopes.orders:write: Place and manage your own orders

role.description: admin is deliberately not accepted here

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
